== bosun's plugin: validate --strict, install, list, uninstall

  · plugin.json: no logo: the plugin shows a generic icon. Add "logo": "assets/logo.svg" (a .png, .svg, .jpg, .jpeg or .webp file inside the plugin)

  skills 0 · agents 0 · rules 0 · hooks 1 · mcpServers 0 · sidecars 0

✔ Validation passed
exit=0
$ agy plugin install /Users/me/bosun/agents/agy-plugin

== a global MCP server, as tests/sandbox/live_agy.sh adds one
$ agy mcp add probe-dummy -- /usr/bin/python3 /Users/me/probe_server.py dummy /Users/me/probe-servers.log
Added MCP server "probe-dummy" (stdio)
exit=0
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "probe-dummy": {
      "args": [
        "/Users/me/probe_server.py",
        "dummy",
        "/Users/me/probe-servers.log"
      ],
      "command": "/usr/bin/python3",
      "disabled": false
    }
  }
}
$ agy mcp list
NAME         TYPE   STATUS   COMMAND/URL
probe-dummy  stdio  enabled  /usr/bin/python3 /Users/me/probe_server.py dummy /Users/me/probe-servers.log
exit=0
$ agy mcp list --json
Usage: agy mcp list [flags]

List all configured MCP servers

Flags:
  -h      Show help
  --help  Show help
Error: flags provided but not defined: -json
exit=1
$ agy mcp remove probe-dummy
Removed MCP server "probe-dummy"
exit=0
$ agy mcp list
No MCP servers configured.
exit=0
